What We Build

Every build starts with the land it sits on.

The Fleurieu Peninsula demands a different approach to building. The coastal weather, the limestone geology, the way the light moves across these hills — none of it is generic. Neither are the homes we build here.

01 — Rural

Custom Rural Homes

Designed for acreage. Built to work with the landscape, the climate, and the life you're actually living out here.

02 — Coastal

Coastal Builds

Salt air and southerlies demand a different kind of build. We know what lasts on the southern coast of the Peninsula.

03 — Renovation

Renovations & Extensions

Bringing older homes up to the standard the Fleurieu deserves — respectfully, properly, and well.

04 — Civil

Earthworks & Site Prep

Earthmoving, drainage, and civil works handled from the very first cut.

"This is not project home country. This is where you build once, and build right."

Hansen Built  —  Fleurieu Peninsula

Dan and Mel Hansen have lived and worked on the Fleurieu Peninsula for years. The land isn't a backdrop to them — it's the reason they build the way they do. Every home they take on gets personal attention, proper craft, and the full weight of local knowledge behind it.

Why Hansen Built

A family name behind every build.

We live here

Dan and Mel Hansen are Peninsula locals. We understand the land, the climate, what it really takes to build in this beautiful part of the world, and the local councils.

Personal from the first call

You deal with us directly — not a sales team or a project manager you'll never meet again. Every build is led personally, which is how it should be.

Built to last

The Fleurieu's climate is demanding. We build to meet it — materials chosen for longevity, details considered for this specific, unforgiving environment.

Trade roots, residential standards

Backed by over 25 years of experience in residential, commercial, civil, and earthmoving. That depth of knowledge shows in every project we take on.

Honest about what we take on

We don't overcommit. If we take on your build, it gets our full attention. That's a promise worth more than a portfolio of half-finished projects.

Referral-built reputation

Most of our work comes through people who know people. The Fleurieu is a small, connected community. We build as if everyone will hear about it — because they usually do.

A good home starts with a good conversation.

Tell us what you're planning. We'll take it from there.
